<div class="card-body">
'''Combined Attack''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">共同攻撃</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">星系で戦闘が起きている時に使う。複数の宇宙船用兵器の運命数を足して、1機の宇宙船を攻撃する。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-75o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">反乱軍の小型宇宙戦闘機は、足並みのそろった共同作戦を取ることによって、ヤヴィンの戦いで大きな成果をあげた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Combined Attack.

'''Card text:''' Use during a battle at a system. Add the destiny draws of multiple starship weapons to attack one starship.

'''Lore:''' Rebel starfighters scored a major result at the Battle of Yavin by flying a coordinated combined attack.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese does not require the weapons to be yours at the same system.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Combined Attack]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
